question.text: Will Jensen Huang deliver the keynote at Nvidia GTC Washington, D.C. before December 4, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, according to Nvidia's i[nvestor relations](https://investor.nvidia.com/events-and-presentations/events-and-presentations/default.aspx) portal or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), Jensen Huang delivers the keynote address at the 2026 NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C. [conference](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/) before December 4, 2026 (EST).
question.fine_print:
In order to count, the address may be delivered in person or remotely, live or through a recording made specifically for NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C. The keynote may also be delivered in conjunction with other speakers.

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46544) which opened on 2026-11-11 12:00:00.

research:
I found nothing showing that the question is settled yet. But Huang is no longer Nvidia's CEO, and Nvidia's own keynote page, which still names him, looks out of date.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-17 (fetched today): Nvidia's GTC DC keynote page still says the keynote is "Tuesday, December 1 | 2-4 p.m. ET" and invites people to "Join us live to see Jensen Huang explore the super intelligence (SI) breakthroughs…" It says nothing about a speaker change. [nvidia.com/gtc/dc/keynote](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/keynote)
- 2026-11-17: The GTC DC FAQ still says "Jensen Huang's keynote address will take place Tuesday, December 1 at 2 p.m. EST." [FAQ](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/faq/)
- 2026-11-17: The main event page lists workshops on Nov 30 and the conference on Dec 1-3, with other speakers (Ian Buck, Kari Briski, DOE's Darío Gil and others). It mentions no cancellation or postponement. [nvidia.com/gtc/dc](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/)
- 2026-11-17: The investor relations events page showed no listed events through my fetch tool, so I couldn't confirm a GTC DC keynote entry there. [Nvidia IR](https://investor.nvidia.com/events-and-presentations/events-and-presentations/default.aspx)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-12: Nvidia announced that Huang had stepped down as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and board chair Harvey Jones is overseeing a search for a permanent CEO. A CNBC source said the board had decided the night before to oust him. The release did not mention GTC DC or any future role for Huang. [CNBC live updates](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html), [Times of Israel](https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-ceo-amid-mounting-scandals/)
- The keynote pages above look like they were not updated after his exit. I found no Nvidia statement saying who will give the Dec 1 keynote, or whether it will still happen. **Nothing has settled the question yet, but a former CEO who left in a national-security scandal now seems unlikely to headline the company's flagship DC event.** That last point is my reading, not something any source reported.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17: Nvidia is due to report fiscal Q3 results today, with Kress expected to make her first public appearance as interim CEO on the call. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html), [PC Gamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware/who-is-colette-kress-nvidias-new-interim-ceo/)
- 2026-11-16: The Daily Caller, citing an anonymous source, reports the board is not considering bringing Huang back despite Trump saying it "certainly isn't a bad idea." The board is focused on its internal investigation, which uses Wachtell Lipton, and on finding a new CEO. [Daily Caller](https://dailycaller.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-jensen-huang-trump-law-firm-wachtell-lipton)
- 2026-11-16: An open letter, "Stand with Jensen," urged the board to reinstate Huang during the investigation. [Spectrum News](https://spectrumlocalnews.com/tx/austin/technology/2026/11/16/stand-with-jensen-nvidia-open-letter)
- 2026-11-16: The US announced a rule restricting remote access to advanced AI chips, linked to the Nvidia fallout. [NPR](https://npr.org/2026/11/16/nx-s1-6042883/nvidia-jensen-huang-commerce-department)
- 2026-11-15: Footage surfaced of Huang dining with Alice Huang in Singapore in December 2023. [Malay Mail](https://www.malaymail.com/news/singapore/2026/11/15/before-the-nvidia-scandal-jensen-huang-met-alice-huang-as-early-as-december-2023-in-singapore/243351)
- 2026-11-12: Rep. Brian Mast said Huang had agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving. The date was still being negotiated. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)
- 2026-11-10/11: The National reported Huang was still listed as the GTC keynote speaker, "assuming he does not resign," even though he had already cancelled several other summit appearances. [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/10/will-jensen-huang-still-speak-at-gtc/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2025-10-28: Huang gave the first GTC DC keynote in person. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/28/jensen-huang-speech-nvidia-gtc-ai.html)
- Before 2025, GTC DC keynotes were given by VP Ian Buck (2018, 2019). [YouTube 2018](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qNMfxbfjvxc), [IBM video 2019](https://video.ibm.com/playlist/656259/video/124512246)
- As CEO, Huang has headlined essentially every major GTC. I found no precedent of an ousted Nvidia CEO giving a GTC keynote. A related case: when Huang pulled out of a February New Delhi keynote, he named exec Jay Puri to stand in for him. [JournalArta](https://journalarta.com/en/2026/11/17/jay-puri-nvidia-madison-huang-yelling/)
- Companies usually replace a departed CEO's keynote slot with the interim CEO or another senior executive.

## 5. Other forecasts
I couldn't find a market on this exact question. These are the closest (prices as of 2026-11-17 15:01 UTC):
- **Kalshi, "What will Jensen Huang say during GTC DC Keynote"**: the market now calls the keynote "originally scheduled for December 1." Every word is priced at about 1-2¢, which suggests traders expect no Huang keynote.
- **Polymarket, "Huang rejoins NVIDIA"**: 2.95% by Nov 30 and 8.25% by Dec 31, 2026.
- **Kalshi, "Where will Huang work next this year"**: Nvidia at 7%.
- **Kalshi, "Trump publicly calls for reinstatement"**: 23% before Dec 1.
- **Polymarket, "Huang arrested"**: 0.9% by Nov 30.
- I found no Manifold market or expert forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: Q3 earnings call. Kress may comment on GTC DC plans or keynote speakers.
- Before 2026-11-26 (Thanksgiving): Huang's possible testimony before Congress, date not yet set.
- Ongoing: the board's internal investigation and CEO search, and pressure from Trump and the open letter to reinstate Huang. A reinstatement before Dec 1 is the main way this could resolve Yes, and markets put it at about 3%.
- 2026-11-30 to 12-03: GTC DC, with the keynote slot on Dec 1 at 2 p.m. ET. Watch for Nvidia changing the keynote page or speaker, or postponing or cancelling the keynote.

Sources: the URLs linked above, plus [Nvidia blog GTC DC 2025](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-gtc-washington-dc-2025-news/), [HotHardware](https://hothardware.com/news/jensen-huang-nvidia-gtc-washington-keynote-new-ai-reveals), [NPR on Kress](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/13/nx-s1-6038868/nvidia-interim-ceo-colette-kress-ai-bets-investigation-lutnick), [Deseret](https://www.deseret.com/business/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-resign-extramarital-affairs-stock-price-chipmaker-artifcial-intelligence-data-centers/).

## Research summary: Will Jensen Huang give the GTC DC keynote before Dec 4, 2026?

The question rests on a premise that no longer holds. Huang resigned as CEO on 2026-11-12. Nvidia's keynote page still names him, but that page appears not to have been updated, and I found no sign that Nvidia still plans for him to speak.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-17: The GTC DC keynote page still reads: "Tuesday, December 1 | 2-4 p.m. ET ... Join us live to see Jensen Huang explore the super intelligence (SI) breakthroughs..." [nvidia.com/gtc/dc/keynote](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/keynote)
- 2026-11-17: The main GTC DC page still lists the event as Nov. 30 to Dec. 3, 2026. Its text no longer mentions "keynote", "Huang" or "CEO" at all. I can't confirm whether that's a recent edit or just how the page is laid out. [nvidia.com/gtc/dc](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/dc/)
- 2026-11-17: The investor relations events page blocked my request (HTTP 403), so I couldn't check what it shows.

### 2. Current status
- 2026-11-12: The board announced that Huang had resigned as CEO, president and board member, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones became board chair. CNBC says the board decided overnight to push him out. [CNBC live updates](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6037833/jensen-huang-nvidia-stepped-down), [Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/nvidia-confirms-jensen-huang-has-resigned-as-ceo-colette-kress-executive-vice-president-and-chief-financial-officer-appointed-interim-ceo)
- Nothing has settled the question yet. I found no Nvidia statement about who will give the keynote, or whether it is cancelled or replaced.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-11-15: Footage from December 2023 surfaced showing Huang and Alice Huang dining together in Singapore. [Malay Mail](https://www.malaymail.com/news/singapore/2026/11/15/before-the-nvidia-scandal-jensen-huang-met-alice-huang-as-early-as-december-2023-in-singapore/243351)

The author guessed Nvidia might send the interim CEO or senior VPs on stage instead, but that is speculation, not a reported decision.   - Rep. Brian Mast says Huang agreed to testify before Thanksgiving.
  - Sen. Tim Scott asked Huang to testify on **Dec. 3**, during the GTC DC week.
  - The DOJ is reportedly looking into entities tied to Alice Huang.

  [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)

### 4. Base rates
- Huang gave every major GTC keynote while he was CEO, including GTC DC in October 2025 and GTC 2026 in March. [CNBC 2025](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/28/jensen-huang-speech-nvidia-gtc-ai.html), [CNBC 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/16/nvidia-gtc-2026-jensen-huang-keynote.html)
- I couldn't find any case of a CEO forced out over misconduct giving his company's flagship keynote a few weeks later. Companies usually take the person off stage straight away. That is my general observation, not a sourced statistic.
- The only past GTC keynote disruption I found was in 2020, when the keynote was cancelled and later moved because of COVID. [KitGuru](https://www.kitguru.net/channel/generaltech/matthew-wilson/nvidias-gtc-keynote-is-cancelled-but-other-streamed-content-still-planned/)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 16 days remain. The keynote is scheduled for Dec 1, and the question resolves around Dec 4. For Yes, Jensen Huang must deliver the GTC DC keynote, in person, remotely or by recorded video made for the event, before Dec 4 EST.

(b) Huang resigned or was ousted as CEO, president and director on Nov 12. Nvidia's keynote page has apparently not been updated since, so it still names him. In practice the status quo is that he does not give the keynote. Nvidia will most likely replace him with Kress or another executive, or cancel the keynote.

(c) Base rate: CEOs forced out over misconduct or national-security scandals almost never headline company flagship events weeks later. The reference-class rate is under 2%. Reinstatements within three weeks are also rare.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - The keynote and FAQ pages still name Huang as of Nov 17.
  - Trump said a return "certainly isn't a bad idea" (around Nov 16).
  - The "Stand with Jensen" petition passed 182k signatures.
  - Kalshi gives 23% that Trump calls for reinstatement before Dec 1.
- **For No:**
  - The Nov 12 resignation took effect immediately, by board decision.
  - On Nov 16 the Daily Caller reported the board is not considering bringing him back.
  - Polymarket prices Huang rejoining Nvidia by Nov 30 at 2.95%.
  - Kalshi's keynote word markets trade at 1-2% and describe the keynote as "originally scheduled."
  - Huang faces congressional testimony requests, one for Dec 3, and there is an ongoing DOJ angle.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** Nvidia quietly updates the page. Kress, Ian Buck or Jay Puri delivers the keynote, or it is dropped, while Huang stays sidelined during the Wachtell investigation.
- **Yes:** Under heavy Trump pressure and a quick investigation finding, the board reinstates Huang before Dec 1, and he takes the stage, or Nvidia lets him appear via video.

(f) The reference-class rate is about 1-2%. Markets imply roughly 2-3% for reinstatement before Nov 30. Even if he were reinstated, it is not certain he would deliver the keynote, so the Yes probability is slightly below the reinstatement probability. A small tail remains from political pressure. I settle at about 2%.

Probability: 2%

(a) About 16 days remain. GTC DC runs Nov 30 to Dec 3, the keynote is set for Dec 1 at 2 p.m. ET, and the question resolves around Dec 4. For Yes, Jensen Huang must deliver the GTC DC keynote before Dec 4 EST, in person, remotely or by a recording made for the event, alone or alongside other speakers.

(b) If nothing changes, the answer is No. Huang resigned or was ousted as CEO, president and director on Nov 12. Nvidia's keynote page still names him, but that looks like a stale page, not an active plan. The Kalshi keynote market already describes the keynote as "originally scheduled."

(c) Base rate: CEOs forced out over misconduct or national-security scandals almost never headline their company's flagship event weeks later. I could not find a single precedent, so the reference-class rate is about 1% or less. The only realistic path is reinstatement before Dec 1, followed by Huang giving the keynote.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - The Nvidia keynote page and FAQ still listed Huang as of Nov 17.
  - Trump said on about Nov 16 that bringing Huang back "certainly isn't a bad idea."
  - The "Stand with Jensen" petition had more than 182k signatures by mid-November.
  - Kalshi prices a Trump call for reinstatement before Dec 1 at 23%.
- **For No:**
  - Nvidia announced his exit on Nov 12, effective immediately, with Kress as interim CEO.
  - The Daily Caller reported on Nov 16 that the board is not considering bringing him back.
  - The Wachtell Lipton investigation is ongoing.
  - Congressional testimony is pending, with Sen. Scott requesting Dec 3, the same week as GTC DC.
  - Polymarket prices "rejoins Nvidia by Nov 30" at about 3%.
  - Kalshi keynote word markets sit at 1-2%, even for words like "Physical AI" that he would almost certainly say if he spoke.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** Nvidia quietly updates the page, and Kress, Ian Buck or Jay Puri gives a scaled-down keynote, or it is cancelled. Huang spends that week dealing with Congress and lawyers.
- **Yes:** Political pressure plus a quick internal finding lead the board to reinstate Huang around late November, and he takes the stage on Dec 1 as a show of continuity.

(f) I start near 1%, matching the reference class and the Kalshi word markets. I add a little for the roughly 3% reinstatement market, discounted because even a reinstated Huang might not give this keynote. I also add a small tail for odd arrangements. Markets look well informed here, and I have no evidence they have missed something. The outcome is nearly but not entirely decided, so I settle around 2%.

Probability: 2%

(a) About 16 days remain. GTC DC runs Nov 30 to Dec 3, with the keynote slot on Dec 1 at 2 p.m. ET, and the question resolves around Dec 4. (c) Base rate: CEOs forced out over misconduct or national-security scandals almost never headline the company's flagship event weeks later, likely under 2%.
